description: Diagnose connectivity, application wiring, categories, root folders, remote path mappings, quality profiles, and hardlink feasibility from normalized inventory.
acceptance: Every finding has severity, owner, evidence references, explanation, and remediation guidance.
Ambiguous path identity and unavailable filesystem evidence fail closed.
Synthetic scenarios cover healthy, partial, miswired, and hardlink-impossible stacks.
The real healthy lab produces no blocker-level false positives.
Real-lab scenarios prove category, application-link, root-folder, container-path, connectivity, API-version, and actual hardlink feasibility findings.
